title: rourea minor subsp. microphylla
intro: Rourea minor subsp. microphylla, commonly known as the lesser rourea, is a plant species in the family Connaraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been used to treat various conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in Rourea minor subsp. microphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
